visualTarget: 4K live-action-film plausibility with physically assembled ground infrastructure and angle-dependent PBR response; no baked lighting or arbitrary dirt.

materials.label: Aged warm-gray pedestrian concrete paving
materials.frontLightResponse: Predominantly diffuse with a broad weak dielectric lobe; aggregate must not sparkle or read as polished stone.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Shallow relief and aggregate become more legible through broad Fresnel lift, never a hard painted stripe.
materials.shadeResponse: Retains warm-gray separation under sky fill and contact shadow.
agingCauses: foot polishing on primary walking lines
rain cleaning on exposed high points

materials.label: Aged precast concrete curb and edging block
materials.finish: dense matte precast face with small aggregate and softened manufactured edges
materials.frontLightResponse: Broad diffuse concrete response with only a weak dielectric highlight.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Chamfer and small chips in the aggregate silhouette catch broad side light; no razor-white edge.
materials.shadeResponse: Contact side remains legible via sky/ground fill rather than black clipping.
agingCauses: soil splash on low vertical faces
minor edge wear from routine maintenance

materials.label: Weathered galvanized steel drainage grate
materials.finish: aged low-satin zinc surface, subdued rather than chrome
materials.frontLightResponse: Subdued compact metallic reflection broken by grate geometry; zinc age prevents chrome appearance.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Strongest edge reflection appears on bar tops and frame lips at shallow angles while recesses remain dark.
materials.shadeResponse: Sky reflection keeps steel distinct from the damp channel below.
agingCauses: localized ferrous oxidation only after coating breach
cleaner top faces from foot contact

materials.label: Aged cast-iron utility cover
materials.finish: dark oxidized cast texture with worn high points
materials.frontLightResponse: Dark subdued metal with broad oxidized highlight and slightly brighter worn high points.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Rim and embossed/raised geometry catch metallic grazing reflections while the center remains rough.
materials.shadeResponse: Must remain distinguishable from a black hole through sky reflection and rim geometry.

materials.label: Saw-cut paving joint/recess
materials.finish: very dark rough mineral recess, not glossy sealant
materials.frontLightResponse: Reads mainly through geometric recess/contact occlusion, not a black painted stripe.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Joint lip catches slight dielectric edge lift while the recess stays rough and dark.
materials.shadeResponse: Dark but never clipped to zero; adjacent paving must preserve separation.

materials.label: Damp concrete drainage channel interior
materials.materialFamily: concrete drainage channel with persistent sheltered moisture
materials.finish: darkened rough mineral substrate; wetness changes albedo/roughness rather than blackening
materials.frontLightResponse: Mostly diffuse dark mineral response under grate occlusion with small wet dielectric highlights only where light reaches.
materials.grazingLightResponse: Low grazing light may reveal a broad damp sheen without mirror response.
materials.shadeResponse: Retains green-gray/brown mineral identity instead of pure black.

assemblies.label: Apartment plaza paving field
assemblies.nominalDimensions: existing fallback field 24 m x 13 m; generated contraction-joint pitch approximately 2 m
assemblies.manufacture: cast-in-place or slab-like pedestrian concrete surface with planned contraction/saw-cut joints
assemblies.mounting: paving over prepared subbase; joints are recessed into the wearing surface rather than painted onto albedo
assemblies.interfaces: building approach, curb modules, drainage frame, soil/grass edges and utility-cover frames
assemblies.aging: foot polishing follows plausible circulation; sediment remains in joints; drain-adjacent zones can retain moisture
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: joint lines, curb lips and cover frame gaps are geometry; aggregate and micro-roughness are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Frame the building-to-ground contact at eye height and a 35-degree downward oblique. At 100% crop, joints must have real width/depth cues, paving aggregate must remain sub-pixel stable, and no repeated dark stain pattern may dominate. Compare dry frontal sun with grazing sun.

assemblies.label: Precast curb/edging module runs
assemblies.nominalDimensions: generated fallback modules use 0.60 m pitch with approximately 12 mm installation gap; exposed section roughly 0.14 m high
assemblies.manufacture: individual precast concrete modules placed on prepared bedding
assemblies.mounting: bedded along plaza/path boundary; module gaps remain physical construction joints
assemblies.interfaces: paving on one side, grass/soil or drainage on the other
assemblies.orientationExposure: top face rain/sun exposed; low side faces receive splash and dampness
assemblies.aging: joint grime, lower-face splash, drain-side moisture; no identical stain pasted onto every block
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: each module, chamfer and installation gap is geometry; aggregate and subtle splash response are material/shader data
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Show three adjacent modules with real gaps and slightly softened manufactured edges. Include clean upper face, dirtier lower splash face and a drain-side damp case.

assemblies.label: Linear channel drain with galvanized removable grates
assemblies.nominalDimensions: generated channel approximately 21.6 m long; grate modules at 0.60 m pitch, approximately 0.34 m wide
assemblies.manufacture: concrete channel/shoulders supporting galvanized steel frames and removable grate panels
assemblies.mounting: grate frame bears on concrete shoulders; panel-to-panel gaps remain visible; bars span the channel opening
assemblies.interfaces: plaza paving edge, curb/drain shoulders, damp recessed channel, runoff path
assemblies.orientationExposure: top steel is rain/sun/foot exposed; channel interior is recessed, shaded and persistently damper
assemblies.aging: zinc dulling and water spotting on bars; sediment/moisture below; rust only where ferrous coating failure is plausible
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: LOD0 frame lips, end frames, individual grate bars and panel gaps are geometry; zinc grain and water spotting are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Use low oblique camera so grate bars overlap in perspective. Show metallic grazing response on bar tops while channel remains darker. 100% crop must reveal panel gaps and actual bar thickness, not a painted grid.

assemblies.label: Pedestrian-area utility covers
assemblies.nominalDimensions: generated fallback uses approximately 0.65 m cover diameter with shallow raised rim and discrete lifting slots
assemblies.manufacture: cast ferrous cover seated in a separate frame
assemblies.mounting: frame embedded flush with surrounding paving; cover sits slightly proud only by manufactured rim relief
assemblies.interfaces: narrow grit-retaining frame seam against paving
assemblies.orientationExposure: upward-facing, rain/sun exposed and foot trafficked; no tire wear assumed in pedestrian plaza
assemblies.aging: oxidation and foot-polished raised regions; damp seam after rain
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: rim, cover disk and lifting slots are geometry; cast microtexture/oxidation are material response
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Show one cover at 35-degree oblique and 100% crop. The seam must ground the cover into paving; metallic response should emerge at grazing angles without turning chrome.

qaRules: No generated high-detail ground part may use Unity primitive render geometry directly; use cached authored meshes or custom meshes.
Generated high-detail visual parts carry no colliders; existing coarse ground remains the gameplay collision surface until collision replacement is intentionally authored.
Drain LOD0 must contain actual bars and panel gaps; a flat dark strip is only acceptable in distant LODs.
Concrete materials must remain non-metallic; galvanized/cast ferrous materials must retain metallic angular response.
Rust is forbidden without a ferrous source and plausible water path.
Wetness must darken albedo modestly and reduce roughness; it must not simply make the surface black.
Foot wear is allowed on plaza/path/cover top surfaces only; tire wear is not added to the pedestrian benchmark without a vehicle route.
No earthquake, disaster or reconstruction motifs are permitted.
Actual visual fidelity remains unscored until native 3840x2160 Unity renders and 100-percent crops are inspected.
